description:
[Skins] Workshop artists behind Rust's skins, by total value. Everyone whose Workshop skins Facepunch accepted into Rust (https://rust.wiki/creators): `steamid`, `name` (from
their latest skin), `avatar_url`, `count` of accepted skins, `total_value` (sum of their skins' Steam lowest
listings, USD cents), `newest` release date and a few `icons` of their priciest skins.
name: list_skin_creators
title: Workshop artists behind Rust's skins, by total value
